contributions.detail: THE SUB-$50 SPLIT, scored per the brief: rows 1-5 (all self-funding by the candidate) sum to 112.50+63.97+48.29+748.00+676.91 = 1,649.67, which equals cover LINE 1 (contributions over $50.00) in BOTH the LAST-REPORT and CUMULATIVE columns exactly. Row 6 (Mike Elder, 25.00) is a SUB-$50 contribution that the filer chose to itemize even though the form does not require it; it equals cover LINE 2 (aggregate of $50.00 or less), also 25.00 in the LAST and CUMULATIVE columns. Scoring all 6 rows against line1 alone would have manufactured a false 25.00 mismatch. The THIS-REPORT column is 0 on every line, so this 2018-11-29 summary restates the cycle: rows are on the CUMULATIVE scope. No schedule total is printed on the Carr form. NOTE the deliberate non-repair: Form A row 4 reads 748.00 while Form B row 4 (same date 5/11/18) reads 773.00. Both were escalated and BOTH stand: each side's own arithmetic closes only with its own figure (748.00 -> line 1 = 1,649.67; 773.00 -> line 3 = 1,674.67). The 25.00 difference between the two sides is exactly the Elder contribution.

expenditures.detail: p3 rows 112.50+63.97+48.29+773.00+676.91 = 1,674.67 = cover line 3 in BOTH the LAST-REPORT and CUMULATIVE columns; THIS REPORT is 0. Rows are the cycle-to-date set, so scope is cumulative.

gates.balance_chain: Cover: 1,649.67 + 25.00 = 1,674.67 contributions in, 1,674.67 expenses out, line-4 balance 0 -- CLOSES EXACTLY (the line-4 LAST cell also carries a scribbled-out figure the filer struck through and replaced with 0). CROSS-FILING CHAIN (same filer, same cycle, both filings in this chunk): the 10/27/18 interim (key d8f94581) prints CUMULATIVE 1,649.67 / 25.00 / 1,674.67 / -0-, and this 11/29/2018 summary prints TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT 1,649.67 / 25.00 / 1,674.67 -- chains exactly on all four lines.
